name: Lahore Feeder Routes (Speedo)
operator: Punjab Masstransit Authority (buses operated by Daewoo under PMA contract)

fare_rules.concessions: Rs25 per Safar (Rs20 + Rs5 raise approved early 2024). Nov-2025 proposal of a further Rs5 raise not confirmed implemented. Free period ended 2026-06-13.

hours.notes: Varies by route (earliest ~05:30, latest ~23:00); see per-route hours. Phase I started 2017-03-20 with 200 buses (PMA).
